narrative.summary: Official Iranian government websites could not be accessed during this review, so no official text could be read and this entry is incomplete. From the official pages that could be located, Iran governs AI mainly through the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution, which in June 2024 created a National AI Steering Council and a National AI Organization and endorsed a National AI Document. A National AI Development Law was reportedly approved in August 2026, but its official text could not be checked. Iran has no general data protection law; a personal data protection bill is pending.
lead_institutions: Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026, but official Iranian websites could not be accessed: every government, parliament and gazette site refused the connection. The one recorded document could therefore only be located, not read, and the reported 2026 AI law and the National AI Document are listed as leads. Iran is marked for a later retry.

instruments.summary: Single-article resolution of the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution that endorses the outline of the National AI Document and delegates approval of its detailed provisions to the Council's standing council (shora-ye mo'in). It creates a National AI Steering Council chaired by the President to plan, coordinate and oversee implementation, and establishes the National Artificial Intelligence Organization as an independent body under the President whose head acts as the steering council's secretary. A note tasks the Vice-Presidency for Science, Technology and Knowledge-Based Economy with drafting the organization's statute within three months for approval.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. All Iranian official hosts (sccr.ir, rc.majlis.ir, qavanin.ir, rrk.ir, isti.ir, ict.gov.ir, president.ir, ai.gov.ir) failed with curl (reset) and WebFetch (503/502). The single record (SCCR resolution 236) is located only from the search engine's indexed copy of the official page; its adoption event was dropped because the date was not read on the source. Iran is not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Searched for Majlis laws and bills on AI (National AI Development Law 2026, Seventh Development Plan Law Art. 65(c)) and the data protection bill; rc.majlis.ir, qavanin.ir and rrk.ir unreachable, so held as leads.; Government: Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution (resolution no. 236 recorded, located only; National AI Document held as lead), presidency and Vice-Presidency for Science and Technology (National AI Organization); sccr.ir, president.ir, isti.ir unreachable.; Ministries: Searched ICT (draft roadmap lead), health/medical ethics, education, administrative and recruitment organisation: no official AI document text located; sites unreachable.; Regulators: No data protection authority exists; searched cyber/passive defence, central bank and telecom regulator AI documents: searched, nothing found.. Not reached: All Iranian official hosts (sccr.ir, rc.majlis.ir, qavanin.ir, rrk.ir, isti.ir, ict.gov.ir, president.ir, ai.gov.ir) unreachable by curl and WebFetch; no document text could be read; Ministry-level AI documents (health, education, justice, defence, finance) not checkable on their sites; Central Bank of Iran, CRA (telecom regulator), AFTA/passive defence AI documents. leads.title: قانون ملی توسعه هوش مصنوعی
leads.note: Reported as approved by the Majlis on 28 Mordad 1405 (19 August 2026), confirmed by the Guardian Council on 4 Shahrivar 1405 (26 August 2026) and communicated to the President for implementation by the Speaker on 22 Shahrivar 1405 (13 September 2026) under Article 123 of the Constitution; 12 articles and 8 notes; gives the National AI Organization a statutory basis as an independent body under the President, sets duties on compute, data access, skills, security assessment and financing, and reportedly a four-level risk classification. Dates come from discovery reports only. No official text could be located on rc.majlis.ir, qavanin.ir or rrk.ir (all unreachable). Record as binding_law once the official text (Majlis law database or Official Gazette) is read. Earlier: 'طرح ملی هوش مصنوعی' general outline approved 28 Ordibehesht 1404.

leads.title: سند ملی هوش مصنوعی جمهوری اسلامی ایران
leads.english_title: National Artificial Intelligence Document of the Islamic Republic of Iran
leads.issuing_authority: Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution
leads.note: National AI strategy (ten-year horizon to place Iran among the top ten AI countries; application areas and enablers incl. data, standards, legal and ethical issues). Outline endorsed at SCCR session 901 (29 Khordad 1403 / 18 June 2024) with detailed provisions delegated to the standing council; reported as communicated to executive bodies in Mordad 1403 (August 2024). Official full text on sccr.ir not located (only a keyword listing page, https://sccr.ir/keywords/1/11996/, and copies on non-official sites); sccr.ir unreachable. Record as national_strategy once the official text is read.

leads.note: Reportedly obliges the government to implement a national AI development programme. Law approved 1 Khordad 1403. Official text page on rc.majlis.ir / qavanin.ir not located and those sites were unreachable; verify Article 65(c) wording before recording as binding_law (AI provision in a general law).
